OptionPackage.DisplayName: SINAMICS Startdrive G130, G150, S120, S150, SINAMICS MV, G220, S200, S210
SINAMICS Startdrive G110M, G120, G120C, G120D, G120P, G115D

AttributeList.Text: Monitors process conditions and sets fault bits in Faults_UDT. Handles EStop detection, temperature faults, sensor health, switch conflicts, and active fault counting.
Here we move a blank set of faults into our current active faults to reset them.

MultilingualTextItem.AttributeList: en-GB Sets EStopPressed when both E-stop channels DI_B_0 and DI_B_1 read FALSE simultaneously (normally-closed, EStop activated).>
en-GB Trips Fault2 if the StatusLED worksheet (mode 2 or 3) is active but DI_A_6 confirmation has not been received within 5 seconds.>
en-GB Sets Fault3 after a 3-second delay when Temp_Fault_Enable is TRUE and AI1.Scaled exceeds the High_Temp_Cutout setpoint.>
en-GB Sets Fault4 after a 3-second delay when Temp_Fault_Enable is TRUE and AI1.Scaled falls below the Low_Temp_Cutout setpoint.>
en-GB Sets Fault5 after 1 second when AI1.Raw reads 0.0, indicating the temperature sensor is disconnected or has failed.>
en-GB Sets Fault6 after 1 second when AI0.Raw is outside the valid 0-28000 range, indicating a potentiometer fault or wiring issue.>
en-GB Sets Fault7 after 1 second when AI1.Raw is outside the valid 0-28000 range, indicating a temperature sensor fault or wiring issue.>
en-GB Sets Fault8 after 1 second when both DI_A_4 and DI_A_5 are simultaneously active, indicating conflicting selector switch positions.>

LineComment.Text: Check each fault in the Faults_UDT structure and increment the count if the fault is active

MultilingualTextItem.AttributeList: en-GB Counts all active fault bits (EStopPressed plus Fault2 through Fault14) and writes the running total to Faults_DB.Faults_Count.>
